sentences.text: 2 12-11-2024 Heard Learned Counsel for the petitioner, Learned APP for the State and Learned Counsel for the Vigilance.

2. The petitioner has preferred the present Cr. Misc. Application No.75938 of 2024 for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Banjariya P.S. Case No. 175 of 2024 registered on 23.07.2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 467, 468, 471, 420 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per the prosecution, FIR has been lodged against the present petitioner against whom there is an allegation that she has obtained her appointment on the post of Prakhand Shikshak on the basis of a forged document.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.75938 of 2024(2) dt.12-11-2024 petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
Counsel submits that the criminal antecedent of the petitioner is clean.

Counsel further submits that at the time of counseling, the petitioner has submitted her original and genuine certificate and mark sheet issued by Sanskrit Shiksha Board, Patna but, during the course of verification, surprisingly, the Sanskrit Ruby Kumari vs The State Of Bihar on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25161898/

sentences.text:
Shiksha Board submitted a report showing the certificate of the petitioner false and fabricated and due to this reason, the petitioner was terminated from her service.
5. Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submits that after the order passed by this Hon'ble Court in Civil Writ Jurisdiction Case No. 15459 of 2014, the amnesty scheme has been published twice, but the petitioner did not opt for the same and she continued to receive her salary.
6.

entities.text: Civil Writ Jurisdiction Case No. 15459 of 2014
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: In this background, this Court hereby grants anticipatory bail to the petitioner in the event of surrender before the Trial Court within a period of 12 weeks from today, subject to refund of the entire amount by the petitioner received towards salary from the date of amnesty period to the date of her alleged termination.

The petitioner shall visit the District Education Officer, East Champaran,
Motihari who shall provide Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.75938 of 2024(2) dt.12-11-2024 her a certificate showing how much amount she has to refund.
The petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with the present matter for 12 weeks from today.

The trial Court on being satisfied that the petitioner has returned the entire amount to the State through the District Education Officer,
shall release her on bail within the said period, on furnishing bail bond of 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, East Champaran at Motihari in connection with Banjariya P.S. Case No. 175 of 2024,
subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Dr. Anshuman, J) Divyansh/-
